arguments.query: SELECT channel, status, COUNT(*), MIN(order_ts), MAX(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY channel, status
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel='store' GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT o.status, SUM(s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL), SUM(s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL), COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status=o.status AND channel='store')) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel='store' GROUP BY 1
SELECT length(order_ts), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE channel='store' AND order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND order_ts<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1
